title: The pillow of my dreams! - Upon Purchase; Time to replace - 13 months later
text:
The pillow of my dreams! - Upon Purchase; Time to replace - 13 months later. I have had every high priced pillow on the planet (yep, I'm a gullible gimmick geek) - memory foam, cooling gel, latex foam (those were the high priced ones back in the day), down, down alternative - and I've bought every el cheapo within driving distance. Nothing ever satisfied me. Low expectations in place, I ordered this pillow. Yes, the individually Thank You note inside is really, really nice; of course the THANK YOU! on the outside of the box makes you feel good about your purchase. But the true test is lying down, doing the flip-twist-flip of getting into the perfect position (I don't have just one sleeping position, I vary from night to night). I was amaZzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzed :) at how truly incredibly comfy this pillow sleeps. I will never, ever, ever buy another pillow of any brand or hype again. This is THE PILLOW.

************UPDATE: It is now September 2015 and for about a month I've wanted to replace this pillow. It doesn't look flat, but I lie down and no matter how much I punch it and flip it and fluff it, the second my head hits the very poofy looking pillow, it goes straight down to the bed like the pillow was full of nothing but air. The "5 stars" feelings of one year ago lasted a couple of months before the euphoria (and some of the pillows perfection) wore off. I would guess that every time I washed the pillow, per manufacturer instruction mind you, it lost a star. Five stars in August 2014 down to 1 star September 2015 averages to 3 stars overall, I'd say (the current rating I've given in this review). Do pillows this price really only have a one year life span?
